_comment: SEMSIM-S4 (OD-1028(48)): meaning-based similarity for topic matching and category comparison. Thresholds are calibrated SEPARATELY and ship null (uncalibrated): any decision with a null threshold returns 'unknown'. Similarity alone never establishes prohibited intent or triggers a refusal. model_sha256 is the manifest hash (vera.semantic_similarity.manifest_sha256) over every file in the model dir, bound to model_revision; verified inside warm() before load. Deployment must set HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1.
